body.message:
Unfortunately, at this time we are unable to provide a fixed quote for the full 8-month period due to market conditions.

We can currently confirm rates for the first 3 months only. The monthly rate of AED 8,000 is applicable for this month and July.

The tentative rate breakdown is as follows:

September: AED 9,000 (30 nights)
October: AED 11,500 (30 nights)
November: AED 13,000 (30 nights)

Please note that rates are subject to change based on market conditions, and we can only guarantee the rates that have been confirmed at the time of booking.

Kindly let us know if you would like to proceed.
